<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="New Vendor Registration">3b4c35de83ff6650a16a74f6feaad369</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Block Submission on Invalid GST</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
   // Get the current value from the GST Number field
   var gstNumber = g_form.getValue('gst_number');

   // If the field is empty, allow submission (assuming it's not a mandatory field)
   if (gstNumber === '') {
       return true;
   }

   // Call the Script Include to validate the GST number
   var ga = new GlideAjax('GSTValidator');
   ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'validateGSTNumber');
   ga.addParam('sysparm_gst_number', gstNumber);
   
   // IMPORTANT: getXMLWait() makes the browser wait for the server's answer before proceeding
   ga.getXMLWait();
   var answer = ga.getAnswer();

   // Check the answer from the server
   if (answer === 'false') {
       // If the GST is invalid, show an alert to the user
       alert('The provided GST number is not valid. Please correct it before submitting.');
       
       // Return false to STOP the form from submitting
       return false;
   }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-11 07:03:42</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>927d206b83ffea50a16a74f6feaad37d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Block Submission on Invalid GST</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Vendor Onboarding" source="x_1821895_vendor_a">cf3b77a1837fa250a16a74f6feaad38b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vendor Onboarding">cf3b77a1837fa250a16a74f6feaad38b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_927d206b83ffea50a16a74f6feaad37d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-09-11 07:03:42</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
